messages:
sam: Quick sync — ACME wants an air-gapped POC. Key asks: signed bundles, delta patches, SBOM, offline installer <4GB, quarterly patch cadence + emergency fixes monthly. Can we deliver?
olivia: @sam good summary. Do they require on-site media delivery or just a jumpbox+USB?
sam: Jumpbox + USB is preferred. They also want a one-time license transfer for offline install.
jordan: We can produce minibundles + deltas. Need to confirm quantized model size. Rough numbers: base bundle ~3.6GB, deltas ~150–400MB depending on model.
maya: Security flags: key rotation attestations, offline KMS workflow, SBOM provenance, and reproducible builds. They want a statement on HSM-backed signing and rotation window.
ben: Ops note — verification needs a 24–48h staging window on their side. We'll produce SHA256 checksums and a signed manifest.
olivia: Can you sketch a sample manifest we can share?
jordan: sure, quick example: ```
{
  "bundle_version": "2024-11-06-rc1",
  "signed_by": "redwood-signing-v1",
  "sha256": "<hex>",
  "components": ["runtime.tar.gz", "models/quantized.bin"],
  "size_bytes": 3865470560
}
```
maya: That helps. Also add fields for "signing_key_id" and "attestation_statement" and a note about rotation: "rotation_interval_days": 365
sam: Pricing question — can we include a one-time offline packaging fee + per-node runtime? Their procurement prefers capex.
olivia: I'll run this with commercial. My suggested packaging add-on: $10k one-time + $250/node/year for offline support (includes signed bundles and patch deltas). Need commercial sign-off.
ben: Technical blocker: USBs may get blocked by corporate logistics. Recommend offer both USB and SFTP-over-jumpbox for redundancy.
jordan: Implementation note: quantized bundles require extra signature step after quantization; expect ~30–60m extra build time per release. Could affect cadence.
maya: Security questionnaire items I'll own — will draft answers for: offline KMS workflow, SBOM generation, signer key custody, and CA rotation playbook. ETA EOD.
deploy-bot: build 171512: artifact uploaded to artifactory: //artifactory.redwood/prod/airgap/bundles/20241106-rc1 (signed) :package: 
olivia: Action items: 1) @maya draft security answers (EOD). 2) @jordan confirm final bundle size after quantization (tomorrow). 3) @ben produce verification checklist + offline install README. 4) I'll draft SOW and price with commercial.
sam: Perfect — I'll update the ACME tech contact and arrange a short call after we have the manifest and price. :thumbsup:
